comparators.definition: Approximate the unknown matrix $A$ within the public linear subspace $\mathcal L=\operatorname{span}\{B_1,\ldots,B_q\}$. Define $\operatorname{OPT}=\min_{B\in\mathcal L}\|A-B\|_{\mathrm F}$; success requires $\|A-\widehat B\|_{\mathrm F}\le\gamma\operatorname{OPT}+\alpha\|A\|_{\mathrm F}$. Finite-dimensional linear subspaces are closed, so the minimum exists. If $A=0$, the output must be zero.

domains.definition: Return $\widehat B\in\mathcal L$, possibly in basis-coefficient form. No certificate is required.
